title: The Fifth Ward school band and its instruments
summary: Lawrence helped the school band get tenor and baritone horns, and says saxophones have replaced them.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: You take, well, I mean, a school band, we have a school band at the Fifth Ward, and the, the superintendent, and the, well, we, I'm, I'm, well, they say good friend. We, I always do the, all the, the mechanic work, tractors and car, and then I begin to work in school, teaching for the school. Well, he asked me about the band, so I told him, I said, the band is not doing too good. He said, well, what's the trouble? I said, well, the boys that, that have music in him don't have the money to buy an instrument and those that got instrument, they don't have music. So, Mrs. Humphress, uh, Willie's daughter was teaching at the time, Willie Humphress. So, he said, well, what do they need? So, I told him they needed a saxophone again, they needed a tenor, they needed a baritone, different instrument I thought would, would improve the band. So, he said, well, you tell the girl to get ready and you take her down to the wall and go get this instrument. So, we went down and get the instrument, but still they, they don't use all of them. You take the, in a brass band, if you don't have a tenor and a baritone, to me, it's not, it's not a good band without that.

That's all, that's all they use, saxophone and, well, they have, they have a tuba bass and trombone, two, three trombone, trumpet, and drums. Well, they don't use the tenor. They had an old tenor there, well, I had that repair and I bought a new one.
That's a tenor horn with a band. Yeah, a tenor horn, yeah. Like a brass band.

Yeah, well, that's a nice instrument, they make nice music with the tenor and the baritone. All big bands are still used, but small brass bands, they don't use them, or full bands, they don't use them.
